title: Vietnamese cement exports rise in June 2026
content:
Vietnam: The country exported 2.9Mt of cement and clinker worth US$111m in June 2026, up by 9% in volume and 5.5% in value year-on-year, according to the latest figures from the government’s National Statistics Office (NSO).

In the first six months of 2026, Vietnam earned US$722m from exporting 19.4Mt of cement and clinker, up by 15% year-on-year in value and 16% year-on-year in volume.
